deleteApp.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteApp.description: This stops and removes the app's containers, then deletes the app. If its node is unreachable the app is still deleted and cleanup retries until it succeeds. This cannot be undone.
deleteApp.pendingDescription: Its containers are not removed yet ({{reason}}). Cleanup retries automatically.

cascadeDelete.label: Also delete everything inside
cascadeDelete.hint: Removes every app and database in it and their containers. Volumes are kept. If something cannot be removed, nothing else is lost and you can run this again.

ai.notConfiguredDescription: Add a BYOK API key in Settings to start chatting.
ai.experimentalOffDescription: AI chat is an experimental feature. An administrator enables it by setting APP_EXPERIMENTAL=ai-chat on the server and restarting the control plane.

controlPlaneRestart.title: Restart the control plane?
controlPlaneRestart.description: The dashboard and API go offline for a few seconds while the process restarts. Running apps and databases keep running.
controlPlaneRestart.consequence1: Open deploys and log streams are interrupted and resume afterwards.
controlPlaneRestart.consequence2: Connected nodes reconnect on their own.
controlPlaneRestart.unsupported: Automatic restart is unavailable here: nothing would relaunch the process.
controlPlaneRestart.stopping: Restarting: the control plane is shutting down...
controlPlaneRestart.waiting: Restarting: waiting for the control plane to come back...
controlPlaneRestart.back: The control plane is back online.
controlPlaneRestart.timeout: The control plane has not come back after two minutes. Check the service on the server.
